findings.summary: Linear scan membership check 'item in allowed' incurs O(len(items) * len(allowed)) time complexity if allowed is a sequence.
findings.suggested_action: If allowed items are hashable or can be converted to a set without breaking nested list equality, consider using a set lookup or specialized structure; otherwise keep in mind the quadratic complexity on large inputs.

limitations: Actual runtime performance depends on the types and sizes of items and allowed.
